about: The curandera's talk-box skin (talk and quests spec, section 4, 'Character skins'; draft 28). Pixel boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] are in the original backdrop (size); breathe and eyes are [x, y, w, h] in fractions of the cropped panel (the two spectral faces at the top, their three eyes); pool is the reading pool's ellipse box [x0, y0, x1, y1] in fractions of the panel.
